content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm trying to connect to a PLC from the [product_name] family [article_no] using a dedicated USB cable to upload the program (we do not have a backup of the [product_name] program). We have two versions of [product_name] engineering software: [version_no] and [version_no]. When I attempt a connection with [version_no], I see the error: "Only diagrams above [version_no] can be updated." With [version_no], the message displayed is: "You must use a newer version of this program." It seems [version_no] is required to connect to this specific PLC model. My question is, how can I upgrade the engineering software from [version_no] to [version_no]? I've found threads discussing upgrading from [version_no] to [version_no], but no concrete solutions. Thank you in advance for any assistance.

Hello [user_name], When using [product_name] engineering software version [version_no], switch to the 'Diagram mode' tab instead of 'Network Mode', and try to upload your program again. Best regards, [user_name]

Thank you, I tried your suggestion and it worked! It functions correctly with [version_no] (it does not work with [version_no], displaying the same message: "You must use a newer version of this program"). I was able to create a backup of the software, although uploading the hardware was not possible. Thanks again, my goal is achieved!

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced compatibility challenges when trying to upload a program from a [product_name] PLC using varying versions of the engineering software. Initial errors highlighted software version restrictions for diagram transfer and support, resulting in uncertainty about which version was necessary. Switching to a specific operating mode within [version_no] resolved the connection issue for program backup, though some backup functions remained limited.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward compatibility between the engineering software and the PLC for program upload and backup. They also anticipate clear instructions or direction for software upgrades.
